one_line: A Ladakhi mint worker of the Namgyal dynasty, striking silver and copper coins for Himalayan caravan trade.

appearance.age_look: Mid-20s, lean and wiry from manual work, average height with slightly broad shoulders and strong forearms.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, light brown Himalayan complexion, straight nose, soft but alert dark-brown eyes; a few faint soot smudges near the temples; default expression is focused and calm, with a small determined half-smile.
appearance.hair: Black hair worn in a neat shoulder-length cut, middle-parted and tied low at the back with a narrow red wool cord; on the head, a simple soft maroon wool cap (pabo-style) with a narrow black band at the base and no metal ornaments.
appearance.costume: He wears a thick dark-brown woollen goncha (loose Ladakhi robe) wrapping left over right and belted at the waist, the robe’s sleeves wide at the wrists; under it, a high-collared off-white wool shirt peeks at the neck; his waist is cinched with a long woven wool sash in muted red and dark blue stripes, wrapped twice and knotted on his left side with the loose ends hanging to the knee; trousers are plain dark grey wool, slightly tapered and tucked into sturdy mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitched bands; around his neck a single plain copper amulet tube on a dark cord rests over the shirt; his forearms have narrow undyed wool wrist wraps, slightly frayed from work.
appearance.signature: A short hand-held minting hammer of dark wood with an iron head, paired with a small round coin die and a thin square silver blank held in his left hand, often shown ready to strike a coin.

ref_desc: A lean mid-20s Ladakhi man with an oval light-brown face, shoulder-length black hair tied back and a maroon cap, wearing a dark-brown wool goncha, off-white shirt, striped red-and-blue sash, grey trousers and brown boots, holding a mint hammer, coin die and silver blank in dark earthy tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a mid-20s Ladakhi mint artisan: a lean man with an oval light-brown face, high cheekbones and focused dark-brown eyes, his black hair shoulder-length, middle-parted and tied low with a red cord under a simple maroon wool cap with a narrow black band. He wears a thick dark-brown wool goncha (loose robe) wrapping left over right, belted tightly, with wide sleeves, and a high-collared off-white wool shirt visible at the neck and slightly at the cuffs. Around his waist is a long woven wool sash in muted red and dark blue stripes, wrapped twice, knotted on his left side with the fringe hanging to his knee. He has plain dark grey wool trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with minimal stitched decoration. Add a single plain copper amulet tube on a dark cord at his neck and narrow undyed wool wrist wraps on his forearms. In his right hand he grips a short dark-wood minting hammer with an iron head; in his left he holds a small round coin die and a thin square silver blank, posed as if about to strike a coin. Use a grounded palette of dark brown, maroon, off-white, muted red, dark blue and brown leather tones, with shonen-anime energy but historically plausible Himalayan garments and materials.
